request.summary: Create a rotating call-center agent status wall backed by an existing agent metrics datasource.
request.audience: Call-center supervisors scanning individual availability and handling performance.
request.primaryGoal: Show eight alphabetically sorted agents per page with unmistakable status and concise handling metrics.

assumptions: The upstream state vocabulary may vary, so state mapping is case-insensitive and unknown states use a neutral treatment.
Logged-out agents remain visible because filtering expectations have not been confirmed with the customer.
The final page may contain fewer than eight agents and must remain visually balanced.

surfaceStrategy.rationale: Agent availability must remain scannable in full-screen walls, wide bands, portrait boards, and compact supervisor placements.

settings.purpose: Message shown when no valid agents exist.
Seconds each eight-agent page remains visible.
Selects the coordinated Light, Dark, or Custom color scheme.

states.expectation: A compact dark placement keeps every descender in the fitted title visibly clear of clipping.
The coordinated dark preset preserves agent-state contrast and title ink clearance.
Ready, busy, ACW, away, offline, and unknown states remain visually distinct.
An uneven final page remains balanced after timed pagination.
An explicit empty state replaces missing agent records.
Long names and statuses remain contained in the agent card.
An unrecognized state receives the neutral fallback treatment.
Rows without names are skipped without shifting valid cards.
Updated state and metrics appear without rebuilding the app.

behaviors.expectation: Known status aliases map to stable semantic visual tones.
Pages contain at most eight alphabetically sorted agents and advance on schedule.
Datasource refreshes replace visible agent state and metrics in place.

visualDirection.summary: A light blue workforce roster derived from the supplied agent-dashboard references, using horizontal agent lanes instead of a dark card wall.
references: User-provided blue Agent Dashboard reference with avatar-led identity and compact metrics.
User-provided light Call Center KPI Dashboard reference with white analytical surfaces.
signatureChoices: Two-column horizontal roster lanes keep identity and state adjacent to compact handling metrics.
Pagination is a segmented progress rail rather than a numeric top-right fraction.
avoid: Four-by-two dark cards with large unused centers.

visualReview.intent: A disciplined operations wall where state color is fast to scan but never overwhelms names and metrics.
focus: Verify the uneven final page keeps the same card geometry instead of stretching a few cards across the canvas.
Verify status colors retain sufficient contrast and long names never collide with durations or metrics.
Verify title and agent-name descenders retain visible ink clearance.
